## Can’t Log In to My ThemeGrill Account

<https://docs.themegrill.com/colormag/docs/cant-log-in-to-my-themegrill-account/>

If you’re having trouble logging in to your ThemeGrill Account, check if you’re in any of the following cases and follow the instruction to get access your account.

**Never Received Your Password or Forgot Your Password:**

For some reason, if you do not have or know your account password, follow these steps:

- Go to the Freemius Password Recovery Page for Your ThemeGrill Account .

- Enter an email address of your ThemeGrill Account and click the button.

- You should get an email with a password reset link. Click the `Reset your Password` button. It’ll redirect you to a new page to enter a new password.

- On the new page, enter the new password you want to change it to and click `Save Password` button

You can see the steps in the screenshots below:

Step 1: Send Reset Password Email

Step 2: Email with Reset Password Link

Step 3: Enter a New Password to Reset

**Didn’t Receive Account Log In Link After the Purchase**

If you’ve not received an email after the purchase, you can contact us via ThemeGrill Site Chat Support or create a Support Ticket here: https://themegrill.com/support-ticket/

Please provide the purchase email address and theme/plan you purchased. We’ll check your account and help you out as needed.

## How to find the invoice of the purchased theme?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/colormag/docs/how-to-find-the-invoice-of-the-purchased-theme/>

When you purchase a theme or product from ThemeGrill, an invoice is automatically generated for your order. This guide walks you through how to locate and access that invoice directly from your ThemeGrill account.

### **Steps to Find Your Invoice**

#### **Step 1: Log In to Your ThemeGrill Account**

Visit the ThemeGrill account login page: https://themegrill.com/account/ . On the login page, enter the following:

- The **email address** used when purchasing the theme.

- Your **account password**. Then, click the **Login** button to proceed.

**Tip:** Forgot your password? Click the **Lost your password?** link on the login page to reset it using your registered email.

#### **Step 2: Navigate to Invoices**

Once you are logged in, you will be taken to your account dashboard. From there:

- Look for the **Invoices** section in the account menu navigation.

- Click on **Invoices** to open the billing history page.

- Here you will find a list of all invoices for your purchased themes and products.

#### Step 3: Locate and Download Your Invoice

From the Invoices page:

- Find the specific purchase for which you need the invoice.

- Click **View Invoice** next to the relevant purchase.

- The invoice will open in a new tab. To save a copy, click **Download PDF**, or click **Print** to print it directly.

## How to Activate ColorMag Pro License? **Pro**

<https://docs.themegrill.com/colormag/docs/how-to-activate-colormag-pro-license/>

Right after you have activated the ColorMag Pro , you’ll need to activate the License of the ColorMag theme. To activate the license, please follow the steps below:

- Go to your ThemeGrill Account .

- Go to **Licenses** and click on the **ColorMag** from the list.

- Copy the **License Key** by clicking on the Copy link.

- From the WordPress Dashboard, go to C**olormag Pro > License**.

- Paste the license key there to get automatic updates and support.

## How to Import ColorMag Demos?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/colormag/docs/how-to-import-colormag-demos/>

After installing the ColorMag theme successfully on your site, you can import the demo. If you do not want to import the demo, you can skip the part and start building your site on your own. However, for importing the demo, you can follow the steps below:

## Troubleshooting common issues after ColorMag v3.0 & Pro v4.0 updates

<https://docs.themegrill.com/colormag/docs/troubleshooting-common-issues-after-colormag-v3-0-pro-v4-0-updates/>

We’ve recently launched major updates for both the free and Pro versions of ColorMag theme . These updates bring substantial enhancements to both the front end and back end of the theme, making it easier for us to develop and release more frequent updates with exciting new features, fixes, and improvements. Plus, your site’s user experience will significantly improve with this update, and we plan to continue elevating ColorMag with each future update.

While it’s unlikely that you’ll experience noticeable issues with your site after this update, there are other factors that could cause problems. If you’re experiencing design issues such as oversized icons, unnatural font sizes, layout issues, or a lack of styling in your page content, these issues are likely due to caching or incomplete migration of customizer options.

### 1. Caching problem (Broken design)

Your hosting company may have enabled server cache on your site. Additionally, you might have used WordPress caching plugins . Normally, the new version of the theme loads on your site after you update it from the WordPress dashboard. However, your site might take time to show the latest version of the design due to the delay in loading the latest styles. There could be various reasons for that. You need to check if the configuration is done properly in the plugin or the server.

To fix this problem, you need to clear the cache. Firstly, if you’re using a caching plugin, try clearing the cache using the plugin’s settings. You might need to look into their documentation. If this doesn’t fix the problem, please contact your hosting provider and ask to clear the server cache.

### 2. Fixing migration issues

Since this update includes lots of customizer option rearrangements, we needed to migrate values from old options to new ones. Unfortunately, some options fail to do so if you’ve imported ColorMag demo before. So, we have added a button to fix the problem. Please read this article and follow the instructions:

Fix Data Migration

This will fix the migration problems and get you back to your normal design.

## How to Remove Example Widget?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/colormag/docs/how-to-remove-example-widget/>

If the sidebars on your site do not have any widgets or if you delete all the widgets from any of the sidebars, you will notice an “Example Widget” will appear automatically on that particular sidebar. Because of this, the sidebars will not remain empty even if there are no widgets, as shown in the screenshot below:

Example widget in ColorMag

In order to remove the “Example Widget”, you can do any one of the following things:

- Change the Sidebar Area to Remove the Widget
- Replace Example Widget With Other Widgets

### Change the Sidebar Area to Remove the Widget

If you navigate to **Appearance > Customize > Global > Layout > Sidebar Layout, **you will get the following options:

- Default layout
- Default layout for page posts only
- Default layout for single posts only

For each of the options above, we have 5 different layouts:

- Left Sidebar
- Right Sidebar
- No Sidebar
- No Sidebar Full Width
- Double Sidebar

From the layouts mentioned above, if you choose **No Sidebar** or **No Sidebar Full Width** layout for your desired page, the Example Widget will be removed along with the sidebar.

You can check the video below for reference:

### Replace Example Widget With Other Widgets

Another way to remove the Example Widget is to replace it with other widgets. As the Example Widget only appears if the sidebar is empty, adding some other widgets to the sidebar will help you replace the Example Widget.

You can add the widgets to the sidebar in two ways:

- Via customizer
- Via widgets page

#### Via Customizer

Go to **Appearance > Customize > Widgets >Right Sidebar**, click on **Add Block** and add the widget that you want. You can check the video below for reference:

#### Via Widget’s Page

Go to **Appearance > Widgets** and click on the **Right Sidebar **widget’s location. You can then click on the **Add Block** button and select your desired widget. You can check the video below for reference:

## How to Edit Imported Demo Site?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/colormag/docs/how-to-edit-imported-demo-site/>

Well, coming up here, you might have successfully imported the ColorMag demo to your WordPress website. Now, you might be wondering how to edit the demo content or replace the demo content, images, Header, Footer, and more with your own.

Most settings can be achieved via the Customizer option available within the theme. To get the customizer, navigate to **WordPress Dashboard > Appearance > Customize**. You will be redirected to the customizer interface, where you will get the site preview on the right side and the customizer menu on the left. You can choose the different options available on the customizer menu for customizing your site.

ColorMag Site with Customizer Option

Go through the following links to see how each section is customized, as well as the options provided by this theme in detail:

- Global – It contains the necessary settings such as Colors, Site layout, Typography options for the ColorMag site.

- Front Page – It contains the settings for the Frontpage of your site, such as Unique Post system, Changing View All text, etc.

- Header – All the settings related to the header section, such as Site Logo, Header Top Bar, Primary Menu, are available in the Header section.

- Footer – All the settings related to the footer section, such as Footer Widget style Footer Bottom Bar are available in the Footer section.

- Additional – Options such as customizing the social icons, Integration to APIs are available under the Additional section.

- Widgets – It includes all the settings of the widgets that are added on the ColorMag site.

## Edit a Page with Page Builder Plugin

<https://docs.themegrill.com/colormag/docs/edit-a-page-with-page-builder-plugin/>

ColorMag is compatible with any of Page Builder plugins like Elementor, SiteOrigin, Beaver Builder, Brizy.

### Set Page Template

- Go to **Edit Screen** of the page which you want to edit with page builder.
- On the right (**Settings Sidebar**), go the toggleable section called **Page Atrributes** and click on it if it’s not already expanded.
- Under **Template**, choose **Page Builder Template** from the dropdown.
- Click the **Publish** button.

Set Page Builder Template with ColorMag

### Edit Page with Page Builder

After doing the page builder template, you can edit the page with the page builder you’re using. Generally, plugins provide a button in Editor that allows you to edit the page with Page Builder. You can search online for their documentation.

## Recommended Image Sizes

<https://docs.themegrill.com/colormag/docs/recommended-image-sizes/>

ColorMag theme recommends a specific image sizes to be used for each of widgets it provides and blog or achieve pages. Following this practice would make your site look good.

We recommend to upload images with the following size that are uploaded for featured image in posts so that it looks good in particular widget or post listing:-

- **TG: Highlighted Posts**: 392 x 272px.
- **TG: Featured Category Slider**: 800 x 445px.
- **TG: Featured Category Slider**: 1400 x 600px while it is full width.
- **TG: Featured Post (Style 1)**: 390 x 205px for the first image.
- TG: Featured Post (Style 1): 130 x 90px for the second image and rest.
- **TG: Featured Post (Style 2)**: 390 x 205px for the first image.
- TG: Featured Post (Style 2): 130 x 90px for the second image and rest.
- TG: Featured Post (Style 3): 130 x 90px.
- TG: Featured Post (Style 4): 390 x 205px.
- TG: Featured Post (Style 5): 390 x 205px.
- **TG: Featured Posts (Style 6)**: 150 x 150px.
- **TG: Featured Posts (Style 7)**: 150 x 150px.
- Archive, Blog Pages: 800 x 445px.

Even though, we recommend these image sizes, it might not be practical to upload the image with the same size in all the cases. In that case, you can upload a larger size in both width and height than the above recommended image size. ColorMag will crop them to the required size and show them to the widget and post listing as necessary.

## All About ColorMag Major Update (ColorMag v3.0 & Pro v4.0)

<https://docs.themegrill.com/colormag/docs/all-about-colormag-free-v3-0-and-colormag-pro-v4-0-major-updates/>

With the latest Major release of the **ColorMag v3.0.** and **Pro v4.0.** there are various changes you’ll be getting once the theme is updated. Since it’s a major update/release, you might find some changes in the different areas of your site. The changes are listed below:

## Customizer Option Rearrange

The customizer option has been rearranged with the latest updates. We’ve tried to arrange it in a way that you can guess easily where it should be.

For example – For changing the category color, please check the location on both the theme version below:

- **Before ColorMag v4.0.0** – Appearance → Customize → Global → Colors → Category Colors.

- **ColorMag v4.00+** – Appearance → Customize → Global → Category Colors.

Similarly, a few other customization options have been rearranged on both the free and pro versions of the theme. In case you can’t find any of the options you’re looking for, you can do one of the following:

- ColorMag Documentation – Search in the ColorMag documentation here: https://docs.themegrill.com/colormag/

- Support Ticket – Contact us via the live support team here: https://www.themegrill.com/

## Design Enhancement

With the Major update of the ColorMag theme, you’ll find changes in the design area on various sections. These include Search Result Page Design, 404 Page Design, Home Page Design, Mobile Menu Design, etc.

Below are the screenshots of** the Search Result Page** comparing the design of various sections with the Before ColorMag v3.0 and Pro v4.0. and ColorMag v3.0. and Pro v4.0.

**Before ColorMag v3.0 and Pro v4.0ColorMag v3.0+ and Pro v4.0**+

## Customizer and Control Design

With the Major ColorMag update, you’ll find the changes in the customizer options area. It includes a Slider control, Toggle Button, Unit Selector, Layout option replaced with Images, and more.

For example: Previously, while changing the Layout Styles on the Blog Page, the option was available in the list. However, with the latest version, the styles are available with images so that you can see the exact design offered by that specific layout.

**Before ColorMag v3.0 and Pro v4.0ColorMag v3.0+ and Pro v4.0**+

## Code Refactor

Previously, the Folder Structure, HTML Markups, CSS Classes, etc., of the ColorMag theme were not updated with the latest coding standard. With the latest version, the code has been refactored and is updated with the latest coding standard.

Below is the list of changes made with the latest version of ColorMag:

- Manage SASS Folder structure

- Consistency of HTML markup, CSS classes.

- Consistency of file/folder structure, PHP classes, functions, and repeated code.

- Mobile-first CSS

- Replace float with Flex/Grid CSS properties

- Use of CSS variables

- Use of SVG icons for default icons instead of FontAwesome and PNG icons.

## What Steps Should I Take Before Updating the ColorMag Pro?

Although the word is big, ‘**Major Update**‘, the process of updating the theme is similar as compared to the other minor release. However, if you have any doubts, you can follow the steps below before updating the theme:

Before updating the theme, follow the steps below:

- Back up your ColorMag website so it can be restored later for any losses.

- Take screenshots or document the current theme’s settings and configurations.

## What Issues I Might Face After Updating the ColorMag Theme?

As mentioned above, the **Major Update** is similar to the other minor updates. However, there is a slight difference where this Major Update has changed the coding and folder structure, HTML Markups, Class, and ID’s name, etc. So if you have made the changes on your site using the code, the code does not work for now.

In order to make the code work, you’ll now need to update the code class, markup, IDs, etc., by replacing it with the one from the new version of the theme.

So this will be one of the major issues you might face while using the latest version of the theme. Besides that, other sections and areas will work similarly.

In case you feel any difficulty while using the theme, please contact us via live chat support: https://www.themegrill.com/ and drop your query. Our support member will get back to you.
